facebook.content:
Beloved, the Lord has placed you exactly where you are for a purpose. He says in Jeremiah 29:11, “I know the plans I have for you,”—plans to prosper, not to harm, to give you hope and a future. Stand firm in that promise; let His peace anchor your steps today.  

Declare: I walk in the destiny God has ordained for me.  

What has God revealed to you this week about His plan for your life?
